(V. M. Kopytov, N. Ya. Medvedev). A subgroup H of a right-orderable
group G is said to be right-relatively convex if it is convex under some right ordering
on G. Is the lattice of right-relatively convex subgroups of a right-orderable group
always a sublattice of the lattice of its subgroups?                       A. V. Zenkov
  ∗ No, not always (P. Monticone, Preprint, 2026, https://kourovkanotebookorg.
wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/21_147.pdf).
